# 如何打印完整的NumPy数组，而不被截断？

- 来源: Stack Overflow
- 原始标题: How do I print the full NumPy array, without truncation?
- 问题ID: 1987694
- 标签: python, arrays, numpy, output-formatting
- 得分: 929
- 回答数: 23
- 抓取时间(UTC): 2026-05-18T09:51:43.713272+00:00
- 原始链接: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/1987694/how-do-i-print-the-full-numpy-array-without-truncation

## 问题

当我打印一个 numpy 数组时，得到的是截断后的表示，但我想要完整的数组。
```
>>> numpy.arange(10000)
array([   0,    1,    2, ..., 9997, 9998, 9999])
>>> numpy.arange(10000).reshape(250,40)
array([[   0,    1,    2, ...,   37,   38,   39],
       [  40,   41,   42, ...,   77,   78,   79],
       [  80,   81,   82, ...,  117,  118,  119],
       ...,
       [9880, 9881, 9882, ..., 9917, 9918, 9919],
       [9920, 9921, 9922, ..., 9957, 9958, 9959],
       [9960, 9961, 9962, ..., 9997, 9998, 9999]])
```

## 最佳回答

使用 `numpy.set_printoptions` : ``` `import sys import numpy numpy.set_printoptions(threshold=sys.maxsize) ` ```
